---
title: "Basemap gallery"
---

Every basemap in the catalogue that needs no API key, rendered for the same
view of the San Francisco Bay Area. The names work as `style` anywhere: in
`basemap()`, `add_basemap()`, `geom_basemap()` and in R and Rust.

```{python}
import basemapper as bm

providers = bm.list_providers()
keyless = [p for p in providers if p["api_key_env"] is None]
print(len(keyless), "basemaps")

images = {}
for p in keyless:
    m = bm.basemap(p["name"], 340, 220, center=(-122.25, 37.75), zoom=9)
    images[p["name"]] = m.render_png()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
# Lay out the images rendered above, with each one's name and form.
import base64
from IPython.display import HTML

cells = []
for p in keyless:
    src = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(images[p["name"]]).decode()
    form = "vector" if p["vector"] else "raster"
    cells.append(f'<figure class="bm-cell"><img src="{src}" alt="{p["name"]}" loading="lazy">'
                 f'<figcaption><code>{p["name"]}</code> <span>{form}</span></figcaption></figure>')
HTML('<div class="bm-gallery">' + "\n".join(cells) + "</div>")
```

The vector basemaps (OpenFreeMap, and Esri's vector styles) are drawn from
vector tiles by basemapper's port of MapLibre GL JS; the raster ones are
tile images. Esri's names have both forms; `basemap_provider(name,
type="raster")` picks the other one.

## With an API key

CARTO, Stadia Maps and MapTiler need a free API key, read from the
environment variable in `api_key_env` (or given as `api_key=` to
`basemap_provider()`):

```{python}
for p in providers:
    if p["api_key_env"]:
        print(f"{p['name']:<26} {p['api_key_env']}")
```
